measure.lexicon: authored open function-word list, not LIWC

thresholds.name: convokit_wikipedia_example_7_7
thresholds.semantics: ConvoKit Coordination._scores_over_utterances: C^m(b, A) is defined only when at least target_thresh utterances of the targets in S_{A,b} exhibit m and at least speaker_thresh replies of b exhibit m. These are counts of marker-exhibiting utterances, pooled over the target group, not plain utterance counts. Values 7/7 are the notebook's Wikipedia example; the paper does not state thresholds.

thresholds.note: the notebook's Supreme Court Figure 5(a) call uses target_thresh=3, speaker_thresh=3; its Figure 5(b) call uses target_thresh=6 with default speaker_thresh=0
plain Eq. (1): defined whenever the target exhibits m at least once, entity needs at least 7 exchanges
